_comment: The cognition engine's authored content (see docs/design/PROCESSING-MODEL.md). OBSERVABLES hold objective reading TIERS (deterministic: deepest tier whose unlock_when you meet; no roll) and an authored VALUE = how much noticing this matters (the one authored worth knob). THOUGHTS are subjective: a self-scaling ROLL, recorded once. Their VALUE (consequence a thought sets in motion), DIFFICULTY (structural + a quiet value nudge), and Spirit EXP are all DERIVED at load -- never author difficulty or spirit_exp. A hidden observable carries visible_when; a thought's set_flag can reveal it, which is how VALUE flows forward. PLACEMENT (where each observable lives + its trigger) is authored in LDtk on the Observables layer, not here. PLACEHOLDER content, matched to the current map (rock/tree/log/water).

add.label: Clear the moss from its face
add.result_text: The moss comes away in a wet green sheet, and the stone shows its grain.

tiers.text: A rock, half-sunk in the grass.
A cap of moss clings to its north face.
Beside it, an anthill worn low into the earth.
A thread of a stream, running clear over stones.
A single tree, standing apart from the rest.
The grass grows longer in its shade. Nothing has grazed here in a while.

observables._comment: HIDDEN until people_lived_here reveals it (visible_when the knows_settlement flag). High value -- this is what makes people_lived_here a consequential (rare) conclusion. Placed near the stream.

tiers.text: A fallen log, squared on one side by hand. It was a beam, once.
A notch cut into its end, worn smooth. Something was joined here.

thoughts._comment: THOUGHT: one observation. Simple structure -> low difficulty. Opens nothing -> low value/reward.
thoughts.text: Worn smooth. Water shaped it, once -- the same water, perhaps, still running.
thoughts.miss_text: There is something about the rock's shape you can't place.

thoughts._comment: THOUGHT: one observation, opens nothing. Common, easy.
thoughts.text: A held breath of a place. You could stay here a while.
thoughts.miss_text: The tree tugs at you, faintly.

thoughts._comment: ACTION-GATED THOUGHT: needs the moss cleared (the clear_moss action's flag). Demonstrates a deed unlocking a thought -- and the way back to one you couldn't reach by looking alone.
thoughts.text: Under the moss: faint chisel-marks. Not weather. A hand shaped this, long ago.
thoughts.miss_text: The grain of the rock seems almost deliberate, but you can't be sure.

thoughts._comment: CONCLUSION: series (rock AND water), feeders, and it REVEALS the log (value 8) -> high VALUE, big reward. Difficulty is structural (breadth 2 + 1 feeder) with a quiet value nudge.
thoughts.text: People lived here once. The water drew them, and they built beside it.

thoughts._comment: PAYOFF CONCLUSION: needs the revealed log AND the prior conclusion. Terminal (opens nothing -> opening 0), but valuable via UPSTREAM centrality (the whole rock/water/log pyramid led here). emotional_weight is the authored dial for the beat a graph can't feel -- this is the quiet gut-punch the wood was building toward.
thoughts.text: They did not leave in haste. They took the roof-beam down, and walked out, and did not come back.
thoughts.miss_text: The old beam holds a question you can't yet read.
